meaning: Reference reception thresholds, not training labels or guaranteed QSO thresholds. Margins inherit SNR calibration uncertainty.

CW_DX.criterion: illustrative 24 dB-Hz service requirement, rounded after bandwidth conversion

CW_COMFORTABLE.criterion: illustrative 31 dB-Hz service requirement, rounded after bandwidth conversion

PHONE_SSB_DX.criterion: illustrative 38 dB-Hz service requirement, rounded after bandwidth conversion

PHONE_SSB_COMFORTABLE.criterion: illustrative 45 dB-Hz service requirement, rounded after bandwidth conversion

conversion: SNR2500 = carrier-to-noise-density in dB-Hz - 10*log10(2500); 33.9794 dB correction
limitations: Fading, Doppler spread, interference, decoder settings and operator skill affect reception.
100 W SSB PEP is not 100 W average speech power; mode power conventions need explicit treatment.
Training currently estimates source-population SNR among received reports; absolute 100 W/dipole calibration is unverified.
